# Contract check: the immediate-return remember

**Date:** 2026-04-06
**Participants:** Wynn Castellano (Staff Engineer)

Wynn: "We ratified the async job contract: remember returns a receipt in
seconds and the extraction is watched by polling a cursor. No blocking
call, and no lost work if the client drops the receipt."

Key decision: remember dispatches, then the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call.

positions.name: AsyncRememberContract
positions.frame: How can remember hand extraction off to the agent without making the client wait, and without losing work if the client drops the receipt?
positions.why: All three segments read the same async design for remember. src-1 reports the ratified contract: an immediate receipt, with extraction watched through a polling cursor. src-2 states the properties that contract must hold: no blocking call, and no lost work if the receipt is dropped. src-3 gives the dispatch sequence, where the agent either polls the run or receives the reaction piggybacked on a later call. The frame holds the tension between a settled contract (src-1, src-2) and a delivery mechanism still framed as an either/or choice (src-3). Its conditional clause ('if the client drops') is held as a requirement, not a report of an event.

placements.title: From blocking extraction to receipt-then-watch
placements.frame: How does this expression hand extraction off so the client never waits, and so no work is lost if the client drops the receipt?
placements.why: The graph has no existing leaves or strata, so nothing is reusable. The three segments share one subject: remember should return immediately, extraction should run asynchronously and be watched by polling, and no work should be lost. src-1 reports the ratified contract, src-2 states its non-blocking and no-loss properties, and src-3 gives the dispatch sequence (poll the run or receive the reaction on a later call). This is a durable theme that future envelopes on async delivery will keep feeding, not a one-time fact, so it is minted as a leaf. No strata tier is minted, because only one standalone leaf is produced here.
